objective: Test whether one shared oneDNN W8A16 primitive with runtime M removes M-dependent rounding and the 168-256-row repeat-nondeterminism without padding work.

treatment.scope: 2-D FP16/BF16 activation by FP8 weight matmul only
treatment.execution_memory: Concrete per-call M source and destination descriptors

required: Every production W8A16 shape has one row-0 class across all tested M
Every tested fixed-M row permutation is bitwise invariant
Every repeated call is bitwise deterministic, including the 168-256-row window
No operator exception, device loss, Xe fault, timeout, or hang
Decode-plateau latency cost is recorded with at least ten warmups

decision.on_runtime_dimension_rejection: Close runtime-M as a negative and proceed to the Triton row-invariant W8A16 design.
decision.on_operator_gate_failure: Do not launch a 27B server; preserve the result and proceed to the next row-invariant mechanism.
